entities.name: Organizational controls
entities.description: Organizational controls

entities.name: Policies for information secu-
entities.description: Policies for information secu- rity Control Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be de- fined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.

entities.name: Information security roles and
entities.description: Information security roles and responsibilities Control Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs.

entities.name: Segregation of duties
entities.description: Segregation of duties Control Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be seg- regated.

entities.name: Management responsibilities
entities.description: Management responsibilities Control Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, top- ic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.

entities.name: Contact with authorities
entities.description: Contact with authorities Control The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

entities.name: Contact with special interest
entities.description: Contact with special interest groups Control The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.

entities.name: Threat intelligence
entities.description: Threat intelligence Control Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

entities.name: Information security in project
entities.description: Information security in project management Control Information security shall be integrated into project management.

entities.name: Inventory of information and
entities.description: Inventory of information and other associated assets Control An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.

entities.name: Acceptable use of information
entities.description: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets Control Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.

entities.name: Return of assets
entities.description: Return of assets Control Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate shall return all the organization’s assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement. © ISO/IEC 2022 – All rights reserved ﻿ ﻿ 11 --``,,,,,``````,,,,,`,`,`,`,,`,-`-`,,`,,`,`,,`--- ISO/IEC 27001:2022(E)

entities.name: Classification of information
entities.description: Classification of information Control Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.

entities.name: Labelling of information
entities.description: Labelling of information Control An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information clas- sification scheme adopted by the organization.

entities.name: Information transfer
entities.description: Information transfer Control Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.

entities.name: Access control
entities.description: Access control Control Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on busi- ness and information security requirements.

entities.name: Identity management
entities.description: Identity management Control The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.

entities.name: Authentication information
entities.description: Authentication information Control Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information.

entities.name: Access rights
entities.description: Access rights Control Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization’s topic-specific policy on and rules for access control.

entities.name: Information security in supplier
entities.description: Information security in supplier relationships Control Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier’s products or services.

entities.name: Addressing information security
entities.description: Addressing information security within supplier agreements Control Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.

entities.name: Managing information security
entities.description: Managing information security in the information and commu- nication technology (ICT) supply chain Control Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

entities.name: Monitoring, review and change
entities.description: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services Control The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.

entities.name: Information security for use of
entities.description: Information security for use of cloud services Control Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization’s information security requirements.

entities.name: Information security incident
entities.description: Information security incident management planning and prepa- ration Control The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information secu- rity incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities. entities.name: Assessment and decision on in-
entities.description: Assessment and decision on in- formation security events Control The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.

entities.name: Response to information security
entities.description: Response to information security incidents Control Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

entities.name: Learning from information se-
entities.description: Learning from information se- curity incidents Control Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.

entities.name: Collection of evidence
entities.description: Collection of evidence Control The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the iden- tification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.

entities.name: Information security during
entities.description: Information security during disruption Control The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

entities.name: ICT readiness for business con-
entities.description: ICT readiness for business con- tinuity Control ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

entities.name: Legal, statutory, regulatory and
entities.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements Control Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization’s approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date.

entities.name: Intellectual property rights
entities.description: Intellectual property rights Control The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

entities.name: Protection of records
entities.description: Protection of records Control Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unau- thorized access and unauthorized release.

entities.name: Privacy and protection of person-
entities.description: Privacy and protection of person- al identifiable information (PII) Control The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws and regulations and contractual requirements.

entities.name: Independent review of informa-
entities.description: Independent review of informa- tion security Control The organization’s approach to managing information security and its implementation including people, processes and technologies shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes occur.

entities.name: Compliance with policies, rules
entities.description: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security Control Compliance with the organization’s information security policy, top- ic-specific policies, rules and standards shall be regularly reviewed.

entities.name: Documented operating proce-
entities.description: Documented operating proce- dures Control Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them. entities.name: People controls
entities.description: People controls

entities.name: Screening
entities.description: Screening Control Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations and ethics and be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

entities.name: Terms and conditions of em-
entities.description: Terms and conditions of em- ployment Control The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel’s and the organization’s responsibilities for information security.

entities.name: Information security awareness,
entities.description: Information security awareness, education and training Control Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

entities.name: Disciplinary process
entities.description: Disciplinary process Control A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation.

entities.name: Responsibilities after termination
entities.description: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment Control Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties.

entities.name: Confidentiality or non-disclosure
entities.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements Control Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organ- ization’s needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and other relevant interested parties.

entities.name: Remote working
entities.description: Remote working Control Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization’s premises.

entities.name: Information security event re-
entities.description: Information security event re- porting Control The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner. 7

entities.name: Physical controls
entities.description: Physical controls

entities.name: Physical security perimeters
entities.description: Physical security perimeters Control Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.

entities.name: Physical entry
entities.description: Physical entry Control Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.

entities.name: Securing offices, rooms and fa-
entities.description: Securing offices, rooms and fa- cilities Control Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and implemented.

entities.name: Physical security monitoring
entities.description: Physical security monitoring Control Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access. Table A.1 (continued) Table A.1 (continued) ﻿  © ISO/IEC 2022 – All rights reserved   ﻿ 14 --``,,,,,``````,,,,,`,`,`,`,,`,-`-`,,`,,`,`,,`--- ISO/IEC 27001:2022(E)

entities.name: Protecting against physical and
entities.description: Protecting against physical and environmental threats Control Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure shall be designed and implemented.

entities.name: Working in secure areas
entities.description: Working in secure areas Control Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.

entities.name: Clear desk and clear screen
entities.description: Clear desk and clear screen Control Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.

entities.name: Equipment siting and protection Control
entities.description: Equipment siting and protection Control Equipment shall be sited securely and protected.

entities.name: Security of assets off-premises Control
entities.description: Security of assets off-premises Control Off-site assets shall be protected.

entities.name: Storage media
entities.description: Storage media Control Storage media shall be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the organization’s classification scheme and handling requirements.

entities.name: Supporting utilities
entities.description: Supporting utilities Control Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

entities.name: Cabling security
entities.description: Cabling security Control Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

entities.name: Equipment maintenance
entities.description: Equipment maintenance Control Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.

entities.name: Secure disposal or re-use of
entities.description: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment Control Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to en- sure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use. 8

entities.name: Technological controls
entities.description: Technological controls

entities.name: User end point devices
entities.description: User end point devices Control Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user end point devices shall be protected.

entities.name: Privileged access rights
entities.description: Privileged access rights Control The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

entities.name: Information access restriction
entities.description: Information access restriction Control Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

entities.name: Access to source code
entities.description: Access to source code Control Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed. entities.name: Secure authentication
entities.description: Secure authentication Control Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

entities.name: Capacity management
entities.description: Capacity management Control The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

entities.name: Protection against malware
entities.description: Protection against malware Control Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

entities.name: Management of technical vul-
entities.description: Management of technical vul- nerabilities Control Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization’s exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.

entities.name: Configuration management
entities.description: Configuration management Control Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

entities.name: Information deletion
entities.description: Information deletion Control Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.

entities.name: Data masking
entities.description: Data masking Control Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization’s topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

entities.name: Data leakage prevention
entities.description: Data leakage prevention Control Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, net- works and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

entities.name: Information backup
entities.description: Information backup Control Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

entities.name: Redundancy of information pro-
entities.description: Redundancy of information pro- cessing facilities Control Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

entities.name: Logging
entities.description: Logging Control Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.

entities.name: Monitoring activities
entities.description: Monitoring activities Control Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential infor- mation security incidents.

entities.name: Clock synchronization
entities.description: Clock synchronization Control The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources. entities.name: Use of privileged utility programs Control
entities.description: Use of privileged utility programs Control The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

entities.name: Installation of software on op-
entities.description: Installation of software on op- erational systems Control Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

entities.name: Networks security
entities.description: Networks security Control Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

entities.name: Security of network services
entities.description: Security of network services Control Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.

entities.name: Segregation of networks
entities.description: Segregation of networks Control Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated in the organization’s networks.

entities.name: Web filtering
entities.description: Web filtering Control Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

entities.name: Use of cryptography
entities.description: Use of cryptography Control Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.

entities.name: Secure development life cycle
entities.description: Secure development life cycle Control Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.

entities.name: Application security require-
entities.description: Application security require- ments Control Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

entities.name: Secure system architecture and
entities.description: Secure system architecture and engineering principles Control Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, docu- mented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.

entities.name: Secure coding
entities.description: Secure coding Control Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

entities.name: Security testing in development
entities.description: Security testing in development and acceptance Control Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.

entities.name: Outsourced development
entities.description: Outsourced development Control The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

entities.name: Separation of development, test
entities.description: Separation of development, test and production environments Control Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.

entities.name: Change management
entities.description: Change management Control Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

entities.name: Test information
entities.description: Test information Control Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed. Table A.1 (continued) Table A.1 (continued) © ISO/IEC 2022 – All rights reserved ﻿ ﻿ 17 --``,,,,,``````,,,,,`,`,`,`,,`,-`-`,,`,,`,`,,`--- ISO/IEC 27001:2022(E)

entities.name: Protection of information sys-
entities.description: Protection of information sys- tems during audit testing Control Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of op- erational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
